Why I am building Citta

A reading space for returning to the ideas that matter.

1 min read

A useful passage can disappear into a stack of highlights. I want to return to it later, see where it came from and remember why I saved it in the first place.

Citta brings reading, listening, notes and review into one learning workflow. Keeping records on the device helps make that workflow personal. Backups matter because people should be able to keep the notes they’ve built up over time.

Citta is still in development for Android and Windows. The first job is to make the ordinary reading and review flow dependable.
